title: Different Doors
description: EEG dataset from 40 participants performing a two-door choice task with monetary gain or loss feedback. Blocks were either learnable, with one door yielding wins 60% of the time versus 10% for the other, or unlearnable, with outcomes drawn from learnable blocks and shuffled so that win and loss totals were matched. Each block was followed by a short survey on perceived door quality, enjoyment, motivation, and performance.
methods_description: Participants completed 20 blocks of 20 trials (10 learnable, 10 unlearnable), choosing one of two doors and receiving monetary gain or loss feedback. After each block they answered a brief survey asking which door was better and whether they had fun, felt motivated, and did well.
